#  Fit models for female genetic effect
```{r}

## Load aggregated data
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))


```

# Model estimates for Table S8b
```{r}
dat <- merged_data |>
  ##dplyr::filter(Batch == 2)|>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("Mon47xBal", "AmxBal", "Par7xBal", "AmxPar6", "Par7xPar6", "AmxRennes", "Mon47xRennes")) #47 rows

n_tab <- dat |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::count(CrossType, name = "n") |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.character(CrossType))


## Female genotype
m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ CrossType, ziformula=~CrossType, dispformula = ~CrossType, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
summary(m2)


## Compute confidence interval for m1
## Refit model nsim times
b1 <- lme4::bootMer(m2, FUN=function(fit) extract_model(fit, estimateCI = FALSE, estimate_response=TRUE, estimate_overdisp=TRUE, newdata=dat), nsim=500, .progress="txt")

## Extract 95% CIs
confint <- data.frame(bCI_tab(b=b1))

confint <- confint |>
  dplyr::rename(lower = X2.5.., upper = X97.5..) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(Estimate, lower, upper), \(x) round(as.numeric(x), 3)))

## Add sample size
confint <- confint |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Parameter") |>      # keep names such as "zi.AmxBal"
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.character(CrossType)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(n_tab, by = "CrossType") |>
  dplyr::relocate(n, .after = CrossType)


write.table(
  confint,
  file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS8a_BoostrapEstimtes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  sep=";"
)

```

# Model selection for females genotypes crossed with Bal males
```{r}

merged_data |>
 #dplyr::filter(Batch == 6 | Batch == 7)|>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("Mon47xBal", "Par7xBal"))|>
  dplyr::pull(Batch)


dat <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::filter(Batch == 2)|>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("Mon47xBal", "AmxBal", "Par7xBal")) #47 rows


## Null model
m0 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ 1, ziformula=~1, dispformula = ~ 1, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)

## Female genotype
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ Female, ziformula=~1, dispformula = ~ 1, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
summary(m1)

## Residuals of msat_bin_zi not OK, so model with betabinomial used for model selection
plot(DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m1, n = 1000))

MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1)

## Compare models based on AICc
modelaicc <- data.frame(MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1))
modelaicc <- modelaicc |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))


write.table(
  tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(modelaicc), "model"),
  file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS8a_AICc_Balmalexfemale_genetic_effect.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  sep=";"
)

```

# Figure S7

# Create a Figure S7 for female genetic effect

```{r}

#Load the data for hatch rate per Couple (506 rows)
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::select(-CrossTypeLabel) |>
  dplyr::select(-Couple_count) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID =as.factor(CoupleID))

# Choose crosstypes
data2 <- merged_data |>
 dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("Mon47xBal", "Par7xBal", "Par7xPar6", "Mon47xRennes" , "AmxBal", "AmxPar6", "AmxRennes"))

# Combine all CrossTypes for one Pair
data2 <- data2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("Mon47xRennes", "AmxRennes") ~ "Rennes",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxPar6", "Par7xPar6") ~ "Par6",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxBal", "Mon47xBal", "Par7xBal") ~ "Bal",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))

#Create order for Pairs
pair_levels <- c("Bal", "Par6", "Rennes")

# Convert the Pair variable to a factor with the specified order
data2 <- data2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = pair_levels))

#Count number of Couples  
##Count the number of couples per CrossType
cross_count <- data2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Couple_count = dplyr::n())

##Create a new label combining CrossType and the number of Couples
cross_count <- cross_count |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = paste0(CrossType, " " ,"(", Couple_count, ")" ))

## Merge the new labels with the data
data2 <- data2 |>
  dplyr::left_join(cross_count, by = "CrossType")

# Plot hatch_rate
data2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossTypeLabel) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
# Add information from the beta-binomial model about median hatch rate for figure S7

```{r}

dataS6 <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS8a_BoostrapEstimtes.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

# Keep the marginal mean hatch rate, (1 - zi) * cond  -> rows "res."
dataS6 <- dataS6 |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl("^cond\\.", Parameter)) |>
  dplyr::select(CrossType, Estimate, lower, upper) |>
  dplyr::rename(X2.5. = lower, X97.5. = upper)

#Quick plot for the models results
ggplot(dataS6, aes(x = CrossType, y = Estimate, color = infstrain)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = X2.5., ymax = X97.5.), width = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ infstrain, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw()

dataS6 <- dataS6 |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add information about hatch rate to the dataset
median_hatch_rate <- dplyr::left_join(x=data2, y=dataS6[, c("CrossType","Estimate", "X2.5.", "X97.5.")], by = "CrossType")

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr::mutate(Cross = dplyr::case_when(
      CrossType %in% c( "AmxBal", "AmxPar6" , "AmxRennes")~ "Reference female genotype",
      CrossType %in% c ( "Mon47xBal", "Par7xBal", "Par7xPar6", "Mon47xRennes") ~ "Alternative female genotype",
      TRUE ~ Cross
    ))

median_hatch_rate_reduced <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

median_hatch_rate_reduced <- median_hatch_rate_reduced |>
dplyr::mutate(CrossType=factor(CrossType))

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr:: filter(!is.na(CrossTypeLabel))

# Plot hatch_rate
median_hatch_rate %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossTypeLabel) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

## create an order 
desired_order <- c(
        "AmxBal (46)", "Mon47xBal (18)", "Par7xBal (10)",
       "AmxPar6 (13)", "Par7xPar6 (34)",
    "AmxRennes (29)", "Mon47xRennes (19)"
   )

# Reorder the rows according to the desired order of CrossType
median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = factor(CrossTypeLabel, levels = desired_order)) 

# Plot hatch_rate
median_hatch_rate_reduced %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossTypeLabel) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = Estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

# Create a Figure S7 
```{r}

## Creat the order for the graph
median_hatch_rate_reduced$Pair <- factor(median_hatch_rate_reduced$Pair, levels=c("Bal", "Par6", "Rennes"))

hatchrateplot4 <- median_hatch_rate_reduced |> 
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = Estimate, fill = Cross), size=100) +
  #ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = x_label_names) +
  ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(ymin = X2.5., ymax = X97.5.), width = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = median_hatch_rate, aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate), position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), size =3) + 
  ggplot2::geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Estimate), y=1.2), vjust = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), size = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Reference female genotype" = "salmon3", "Alternative female genotype" = "salmon")) +
  labs(x = "Cross", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Median hatch rate and individual hatch rates per cross (female strain x male strain)", fill = "Female type") +
  #ggh4x::facet_nested(~Pair, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  ggh4x::facet_nested(~Pair, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  #ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ LineType + Pair_Type, ncol = 4, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "top", drop=FALSE, labeller = label_bquote( cols = Pair_Type)) +
  ##ggplot2::facet_grid(Continent~Pair, switch = NULL, scales = "free", space = "fixed") +
  theme_grey(base_size = 30) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20, "pt"),
        #strip.background = element_blank(),  # Removes background from facet labels
        strip.placement = "outside", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=30, angle = 45, hjust = 1), #modify the text of the axis x
        axis.text=element_text(size=20),
        title = element_text(size = 0), #face="bold" makes it bold
        axis.title=element_text(size=35,face="bold"),
        legend.text=element_text(size = 30),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 30),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size =45),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey")) + # text for the subtitles/strips
        theme(
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.position = "top"
          )

#save bar plot
title_plot <- "Fig.S8.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   hatchrateplot4, base_height = 40/cm(1),
                   base_width = 100/cm(1), dpi = 1200)


```
